body_lead: CHENNAI: The school education department is planning to expand its emerging technologies curriculum — currently implemented under the TN SPARK programme on a pilot basis in about 5,000 schools — to all government schools for students of classes 6 to 8. Similarly, during the next phase, textbooks would be developed under the curriculum and introduced to students of classes 9 to 12.
